name: Jax
_comment_paths: base_blend (master .blend containing the armature) and blender_exe (Steam Blender binary) are machine-specific. Do NOT commit personal absolute paths to this public repo. Supply them via process_take CLI flags (--base-blend / --blender-exe), the MELODICCAP_BLENDER env var, or an untracked characters/jax.local.json that deep-merges over this file.
_comment_bone_map: Proven SMPL (BVH source joint) -> JaxRigify map for the automated FK-driven retarget. With ik_fk_one forcing IK_FK=1.0 on every limb, the FK rotation chain (hip->knee->ankle->foot_fk, shoulder->elbow->wrist->hand_fk) drives end-effector positions correctly -- no COPY_LOCATION IK targets needed (and adding them stretches the rig because the source pelvis sits at world origin while JaxRigify's pelvis is up at ~0.9m; Rigify's IK_Stretch then pulls the limb to reach the displaced IK target). The manual Rokoko recipe in wham/README.md adds *_foot/*_hand -> *_ik COPY_LOCATION entries on top of these 18, because Rokoko auto-scales/aligns the source and its IK targets land sanely; do NOT add them here.
_comment_calibration: Optional per-target-bone escape hatch, used ONLY if a real take shows a bone rotated wrong vs the ground-truth Rokoko bake. e.g. "upper_arm_fk.L": { "invert": [false, true, false] }. Default: none.
_comment_ik_follow_fk: Pure visual / parity. Per frame, drives each IK target's head to its FK counterpart's tail (the end-effector world position). With ik_fk_one enforcing FK, the IK chain is dormant -- but its widget bones still display at rest, which reads as 'hands not moving' on a posed body. This block keys their location to follow the FK end-effector so the rig reads correctly and stays sane if a shot later switches IK_FK back to 0 for a specific limb.
_comment_about_offsets: rot_offset_euler_deg is added AFTER the SMPL axis-angle is converted to a Blender quaternion. Use it to absorb mismatches between SMPL's joint frame and the Rigify bone's roll. Common values are 0 / +/- 90 / +/- 180. Edit these during Phase F calibration when you see a bone rotated wrong on a real take.
_comment_about_root: Options: 'ignore' (best for Path A monocular — drift-prone; keyframe walk path by hand), 'follow' (use SMPL trans as-is), 'follow_xy' (XY only, hold Z at rest — useful for sit/stand transitions).

axis_conversion._comment: Whole-armature rotation applied to the rig OBJECT before per-bone rotations. JaxRigify is already built standing upright in Blender's Z-up world, so the rest pose (all-zero SMPL rotations) should land on Jax's existing T-pose — no whole-body rotation needed. SMPL/Blender axis differences are handled per-bone via rot_offset_euler_deg above. Keep this at [0, 0, 0] unless a future character needs the whole rig flipped (e.g. an asset imported from a Y-up DCC). If a real take comes in lying on its face, fix the per-bone offsets, NOT this value.
